mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fallbackUsed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fallbackCalls, COALESCE(SUM(inputTokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(outputTokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(totalTokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(estimatedCostCny), 0) AS totalEstimatedCostCny, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(latencyMs)), 0) AS avgLatencyMs FROM ai_usage_log WHERE userId = #{userId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(totalTokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(estimatedCostCny), 0) AS estimatedCostCny FROM ai_usage_log WHERE userId = #{userId} AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
